LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet (2 sessions) • Symbols/Characters of
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Visuals, part of Writing 3.1 Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet (2 sessions) • Symbols/Characters of in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you take care of household items? 2. Why are pictures used to communicate?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to list the household items and rooms found in the house,

2. draw, colour and label household items of their choice in groups,

3. share their artistic works with peers for review,

4. work jointly to organise their work in the class portfolio,

5. match images of household items to their names,

6. work in pairs to write simple words describing household items/rooms in the house. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to list the household items and rooms found in the house,
2. draw, colour and label household items of their choice in groups,
3. share their artistic works with peers for review,
4. work jointly to organise their work in the class portfolio,
5. match images of household items to their names,
6. work in pairs to write simple words describing household items/rooms in the house. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: This is enhanced as the learner weighs possible ideas when matching images of

household items to their names.

• Creativity and imagination: This is nurtured as the learner embraces ideas that ignite creativity when drawing, colouring and

labelling household items of their choice in groups.
